quote: An amount of ad-hoc payment not less than 75% of the net amount of the bill under check, shall be made within 10 working days of submission of the bill. The remaining payment is also to be made after final checking of the bill within 28 working days of submission of bill by the contractor.
notes: Two periods: an ad-hoc payment of at least 75% of the net bill within 10 working days of submission, and the remaining payment within 28 working days of submission. Simple interest at 5% a year if an intermediate bill is paid more than 45 days after submission. REVIEWER DECISION: the key records 28 working days (full payment).

unit: % of each running and final bill
quote: to deduct a sum at the rate of 2.5% of the gross amount of each running and final bill till the sum deducted will amount to security deposit of 2.5% of the tendered amount of the work.
notes: This is a SECURITY DEPOSIT deducted from every running and final bill until it reaches 2.5% of the tendered amount; it is treated as retention for this project. The blank form on PDF p205 also lists 'Security Deposit 2.5% of tendered value'. It can be replaced by securities or an FDR, or released against a bank guarantee (p29). Release (17.6, p79): 50% retained for 18 months from completion (or until the final bill is passed, whichever is later) and the other 50% after the defect liability period, which is 3 years (17.2, PDF p75).

quote: Mobilization advances not exceeding 10% of the tendered amount may be given, if requested by the contractor in writing within six months of the order to commence the work.
notes: Optional: 'may be given' if requested in writing within six months of the order to commence. Released in two or more instalments, none above 5% of the tendered amount. Simple interest 8% a year; recovery from bills starts after the first 10% of work and must finish by the time 80% of the work is paid (10B(iv), PDF p57). Bank guarantees for 110% of the advance are required (PDF p55). The same clause also has a secured advance on materials of up to 75% of assessed value (10B(i)) and a plant and machinery advance of up to 5% (10B(iii), PDF p55).

quote: @ 0.75% of accepted tendered amount per month of delay (to be computed on per day basis)
notes: Compensation for delay is 0.75% of the accepted tendered amount per month of delay (computed on a per-day basis), with a total cap of 5% of the tendered value. If the contract is determined, compensation under Clause 2 plus forfeiture under Clause 3 together may not exceed 8% (PDF p33). Milestone amounts in Schedule F are withheld automatically when a milestone is missed (PDF p33).

quote: If the prices of materials and/or wages of labour required for execution of the work increase, the contractor shall be compensated for such increase as per provisions detailed below and the amount of the contract shall accordingly be varied
notes: Clause 10CC compensates for increases in material prices and wages, worked out quarterly with index formulae. Available only for work done within the stipulated (or justified extended) period without action under Clause 2. The cost of work on which escalation is paid is W = 0.85 M (PDF p59), and the first payment comes three months after the month of commencement (p59). The component percentages are pre-determined in Schedule F, which is not filled in this document.

quote: The contractor shall submit an irrevocable Performance Guarantee at specified percentage of the tendered amount as mentioned in Schedule
notes: The clause exists but the PERCENTAGE IS NOT GIVEN in this document: Clause 1 refers to Schedule 'E', and the blank form on PDF p205 reads 'Performance Guarantee % of tendered value.' with no number. It must be valid until the stipulated completion date plus at least 6 months, and can be an Insurance Surety Bond, DD, FDR or bank guarantee. For maintenance contracts 50% of the guarantee is retained as Security Deposit.
